## Review checklist

- [ ] Read relevant AGENTS/ADR/spec and kept the change focused.
- [ ] Updated docs, schema/API, migration, changelog and backlog where needed.
- [ ] Added risk-appropriate tests and included actual evidence.
- [ ] Confirmed model/UI/MCP metadata cannot grant authority.
- [ ] Used synthetic data; no secrets or customer artifacts included.
- [ ] Listed residual risk and follow-up work.
